fixture: One synthetic accepted order, total 2250 minor units, quantity two at 1125 each. Initial state placed except different-actions starts preparing. Initial version zero.
baseline: Unconditional status/bill writes with the same atomic event logging and permissions
revision: Permitted state and expected version checked in the atomic update
sequential: Every state pair, including all after-payment changes, is checked separately in the automated suite.
overlap: Concurrent pairs are released together at a client barrier; server start/end logs must confirm overlap. Delayed-old-action deliberately executes after newer accepted actions.
recovery: Distinct action IDs for main conflicts. A separate lost-payment-acknowledgement regression verifies the database event before dropping the response.
analysis: History is the comparison unit. The checker records invalid transitions, stale writes, broken histories, missing accepted events, changed totals, valid sequential rejections and unresolved responses. A 409 alone is not a pass.
